layer1.name: Fathom Analytics
layer1.one_liner: Privacy-focused website analytics that does not use cookies.
layer1.description: A simple analytics dashboard positioned on privacy compliance and speed, sold as a subscription. Began as an open-source side project before becoming a hosted paid product.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped with no outside funding to thousands of paying customers, profitable enough to pay both founders full time. Revenue figures are less precisely disclosed than the other entries here.

sources.note: Co-founder interview on bootstrapping against Google Analytics
